crop.notes: Part of a Theatre Comique program listing; begins mid-advertisement at 'BENEFIT OF TOM ALLEN, on which occasion', so the theatre name and date above are not in the clipping.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; many performer names garbled.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a variety program for the benefit of Tom Allen, at which Bauer and Christol would wrestle, along with singers, dancers, a club swinger and a ballet.

metadata.notes: Same page as 538 (The St. Louis Republican, March 30, 1876, page 5). The clipping does not mention Ned Donnelly or the McCoole belt; the current summary draws those from 538.

facts.fact: The program for Allen's benefit included a wrestling match between Bauer and Christol and a variety bill
